verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_1: O Lord, what is the Unsurpassable that grants Kaula fruit at once — known by a mere touch of knowing, rising to kinship with the Sky-Goer?
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_2: Tell me this secret of secrets, Lord — the Power that dwells in the heart, Kaulikī, mistress of the clan.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_3: Tell me of her, Lord of gods, by whom I come to fullness. — Hear, blessed Goddess: even the answer has one beyond it — the Unsurpassable.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_4: This Kaula rite, O Goddess, standing in my heart-sky — I tell it, O lady of gods: it gives swift Kaula fruit.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_5: First now: all lunar days, vowels ending in the drop; within them, by time's conjoining, moon and sun are named.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_6: Realities from earth to person, in five groups in order — in ka-series, in sounds, ending with the ma-sound, O fair-vowed one.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_7: Fourfold the holds of wind, fire, water and their lords; above them, śa beginning the famed row, and before, the five Brahmas.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_8: Rootless, rightly ranged, to be known, ending in kṣa — this forthgoing declared; of all mantras indeed, and of wisdoms, O glorious one.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p01_9: This is the womb, told in all Tantras in every way — joined with the fourteen, O lucky one, joined with the tithi-lord's end; the third godhead, O fair-hipped, the heart of Bhairava himself.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_10: Neither yoginī-born nor Rudra plainly wins this heart of the god of gods, swift giver of yoga's release.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_11: At its right speaking, the great mantra-seal host comes face to face at once — marked by possession of one's own body.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_12: Who remembers for a moment — in the kiss, navel-sealed — he binds then all, body and mantra-seal host, the man.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_13: Asked, he tells past and future things — even within a watch, uttering the meant god-form.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_14: Face to face he sees the sure, drawn by Rudra's powers; in two watches' time, sky-standing, remembering.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_15: By three: all mothers, mighty yoginīs, heroes, hero-lords, adepts, and the strong śākinī throng.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_16: They come, pledge got, by Bhairava urged — they grant supreme fruition, whatever fruit is wished.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_17: By this the perfected will perfect, and make mantra-men perfect; whatever is in Bhairava's Tantra, all succeeds from this.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p02_18: Who thus truly knows even the unseen circle shares fruition ever — yogin and initiate alike.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_19: By this mere knowing, all powers know; a kinsman of the śākinī clan he may be, even without yoga.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_20: Ignorant of rite, knowing ordinance, he turns to worship — having made time-fire from the first, ending in māyā, gone to the brahma-body.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_21: Śiva, whose end is endless all, deemed the supreme power-triad; whatever stands on the pure path abides inside that.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_22: The atom soon attains pure lordly knowing; its mover is Śiva to be known, all-knowing highest Lord.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_23: All-going, stainless, clear, full, self-aboded, bright — like the great power-formed tree standing in the banyan seed.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_24: So stands this moving-still world in the heart-seed; who knows it truly — his is the freedom-going.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_25: Initiation becomes undoubted, free of sesame-ghee offering — on crown, face, and heart, on the hidden, on the form, and so indeed.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_26: Placing done, topknot bound, twenty-seven-muttered; with each one let the ten quarters' binding be yoked.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p03_27: Three claps first, sounded, to clear obstacles; with topknot-count thrice-told, then sprinkle water.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_28: Flowers and all in order — emblem or altar; with fourteen mutterings, a flower-seat made.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_29: There let the hero worship the forthgoing, then the seat again; casketed, let him begin the worship after.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_30: Full of all realities, graced with all ornaments — let the great lady worship the goddess, twenty-seven-named.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_31: Then with fragrant flowers, as able, let him honor; worship with supreme devotion, and offer up himself.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_32: Thus worship told; in fire-rite too this rule: who did the worship-rule, rightly remembering the seed, succeeds.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_33: Beginningless-endless seed, abloom, gone mid-tithis — housed in the heart-lotus, meditate the moon-ray, ever practise.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_34: Which desires he desires, them quickly may he win; from this he goes to direct sight — all-knowingness, no doubt.
verses.ptvmadhyama_ptvm-p04_35: Thus is mantra-fruit got — this Rudrayāmala; from this practice, accomplishment and all-knowingness are won.
